signal: Lambda raised over $1.5B Series E and signed multi-billion-dollar GPU deals with Microsoft and Nvidia, building gigawatt-scale AI factories ahead of a potential 2026 IPO.

email.body1:
Matt, saw Lambda raised over $1.5B and signed major GPU deals with Microsoft and Nvidia while building out gigawatt-scale AI factories.

Scaling that fast usually means far more strategic accounts in play than the team can cover before everyone ramps, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your strategic accounts off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up on the strategic business development side.

With infrastructure scaling this fast, the target list usually outpaces the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to cover it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your strategic motion needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for your Lambda team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer AI-infrastructure teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you build out the AI factories, no problem at all. A pre-IPO stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic business development motion? I'll tailor it to Lambda either way.
